title: Marsha Acker (Elevate Dialogue CEO) on the STATION DC fireside
summary: Marsha Acker — CEO and Co-Founder of Elevate Dialogue, executive coach, author of Staying In It — leaves the STATION DC fireside saying she hasn't been so moved by a new book in a long time.
blockquote: It's been a long time since I've been so moved by a new book and the message behind it!
